scripts.text: Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation: 自己的家乡之外已经够痛苦了，还得面对爱抱怨的人类。别烦我！

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
scripts.translation: 我们是最坚韧的种族。无论

scripts.text: how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation: 环境多么恶劣，我们都能生存。

scripts.text: I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
scripts.translation: 我猜你那迟钝的脑袋无法理解

scripts.text: it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
scripts.translation: 住在我的故乡究竟有多难熬，
不过你可以试着想象一下。

scripts.text: Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 你们人类引以为傲的大部分知识和技能，可能都是矮人传授的。

scripts.text: This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation: 锻造方面。就连众神的工具和武器也是我的祖先打造的。你知道吗？

scripts.text: We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation: 我们拥有最渊博的知识和技艺，却只能认命，住在巨人族那片寒冷贫瘠的土地上。

scripts.text: Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
scripts.translation: 你刚才是不是问我在这里做什么？哈哈哈！我在等那些蠢到敢来的

scripts.text: here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation: 人类，好让我把他们揍一顿！

scripts.text: Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
scripts.translation: 别担心。我才不屑和你这种弱者交手，免得自取其辱。人类如此脆弱，却固执地抱着傲慢，彼此争斗

scripts.text: As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 你们这个种族真是无可救药。我一点也不想和人类住在同一片大陆上！可惜我别无选择。

scripts.text: disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation: 在一千年前的战争后消失了。不知为何，我再也找不到穿过世界树回去的路...
我被困在米德加尔特了。

scripts.text: At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation: 至少我有幸找到这个洞穴。毕竟我们矮人最喜欢住在地下。

scripts.text: I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation: 我需要一些材料才能替你打造武器。你想要哪一件？

scripts.text: However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation: 不过，现在还不是打造女神项链的时候。你必须等封印解除后再来。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation: 不过雷神腰带的封印还没有解除。在那之前，你只能等着！哇哈哈！

scripts.text: But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation: 即使如此，在封印解除之前我也无法打造史雷普尼尔。人类，想要就只能等。哈哈～！

scripts.text: But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation: 不过只要封印还在，我连雷神之锤的仿制品都做不出来。等封印解除后再来。哇哈哈！

scripts.text: We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation: 我们矮人可不屑在卑微的人类面前展示技艺！

scripts.text: Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation: 别来烦我，快滚出去！去找魔物玩吧，没脑子的蠢货！

scripts.text: no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!
scripts.translation: 但我不得不尊重命运选中的人。带上你的^0000FF公会会长^000000来！

scripts.text: Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...
scripts.translation: 要把珍贵的技艺展示给人类，实在令我羞耻...

scripts.text: All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.
scripts.translation: 所有封印都已解除，持有公会徽章的人是命运选中的人。我不得不尊重你。

scripts.text: First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!
scripts.translation: 首先，我要确认你是否带齐了锻造神器所需的材料！我最讨厌人类毫无准备地跑来浪费时间！

scripts.text: How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
scripts.translation: 竟敢没准备好就跑来？！忘了该带什么材料吗？这次听仔细了！

持有公会徽章的人才能

scripts.text: humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.
scripts.translation: 替人类做事很丢脸。不过，既然命运选中了你成为公会徽章的持有者，我也只能答应你的请求。

scripts.text: ^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...
scripts.translation: ^FF000010分钟^000000来重铸一件神器。时间一到，封印就会恢复；在它们再次解除之前，我什么也做不了...

scripts.text: This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation: 这条项链只有戴在女神菲力亚身上才有意义。

scripts.text: But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures
scripts.translation: 不过我有什么资格评判你呢？这些宝物

scripts.translation: 会自行选择主人。看看女神项链是否认可你！

scripts.text: Ah, just look at this dazzling beauty. No other piece of jewelry complemented Freya as well as Brisingamen.
scripts.translation: 啊，看看这耀眼的美丽。没有任何珠宝比女神项链更衬菲力亚。

scripts.text: This belt was worn long ago by Thor, the mightest warrior ever. But since these treasures select their owners, we'll see whether or not it recognizes you as worthy!
scripts.translation: 这条腰带曾由最强的战士托尔穿戴。但这些宝物会自行选择主人，我们就看看它会不会认可你吧！
